scope: One predeclared outer fold (fold 0) using train-role group-OOF rows for fitting and the independent selection role for matched-budget development diagnostics; evaluation labels are not read or scored.
delta: Delta = 1[ h0 != y ] - 1[ h1 != y ], values in {-1,0,+1}; +1 is a correction, -1 is an introduced error
training_target: train-role genuine group-OOF predictions from seed_42_fold_0/oof_predictions.npz only
budget_definition: expected evidence calls per row; second-call quota K = round((budget - 1) * N_selection), with deterministic tie handling; effective budget is reported
matched_budget: confidence and predicted-delta gates acquire exactly K selection rows; hash-random uses SHA256(sample_hash) ascending and the same K; all_average acquires every selection row and is reported as a 2.0-call reference
selection_lock: No model, feature, threshold, budget, or policy may be changed after selection diagnostics; no evaluation scoring is performed.
stop_rules: role/capture/session mismatch or input hash change
evaluation labels accessed or evaluation rows scored
router state contains forbidden second-view information
no correctable space (all train Delta == 0 and no selection policy can differ)
no effective selection difference after matched-budget accounting
insufficient support for the fixed regressor fit or group-level diagnostics
negative damage being zero is not treated as a safety guarantee
interpretation: Development diagnostic on previously exposed USTC data; no final generalization, fresh blind-test, or real end-to-end latency claim. Zero or negative damage is retained as an observed outcome only.
